{{Quote|Sir, we've been instructed to bring you down to the infirmary.|Saltern, to Jareth Sartoris|<ref name="Death Troopers">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>}}
'''Saltern''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a guard aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the ''Purge'' broke down while undertaking a voyage to the [[detainment moon]] [[Gradient Seven]], and several crew members from the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] boarded a nearby [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|derelict Star Destroyer]] to look for spare parts. However, the boarding party were exposed to the deadly [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|blackwing virus]] while on the ship and, after they returned to the ''Purge'', several of them [[Death/Legends|died]] from the infection. Saltern and another guard donned bio-suits and were sent to escort [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] [[Jareth Sartoris]]&mdash;the leader of the boarding part&mdash;to the barge's infirmary, to put him into quarantine.
